temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn has been unusually quiet and withdrawn over the past few days. When Carolyn asks if she is alright, Marilyn says she is overwhelmed with work and personal stuff and thanks Carolyn for asking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn generally sees Marilyn as normally engaging and has no specific belief that Marilyn is struggling.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Marilyn's unusual withdrawal and her admission that she is overwhelmed lead Carolyn to believe Marilyn is under significant work and personal stress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is overwhelmed by work and personal issues and may need support, though she is not sharing details yet.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, empathetic, and slightly reassured that Marilyn responded.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To check in supportively, remain available, and give Marilyn room to talk when she is ready.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After Marilyn responded curtly in a later interaction, Carolyn shares that she has had tough times too and that talking can help. Marilyn appreciates it, apologizes if she seemed off, and says it has been a hard week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes Marilyn's curtness may mean Carolyn overstepped or that there is tension/misunderstanding between them; she feels confused and slightly hurt.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Marilyn explains the curtness as due to a hard week, apologizes, and shows appreciation for Carolyn's openness.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn's behavior was likely caused by her own stress rather than rejection, and she is receptive to Carolyn's support.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Relieved, empathetic, and cautiously hopeful after initial confusion and hurt.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To clear misunderstandings, show support, and continue building a supportive connection with Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After their last conversation, Marilyn seems to respond positively to Carolyn's openness. Carolyn invites Marilyn to a small weekend gathering, and Marilyn says it sounds lovely, thanks her, and says she would love to join.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes their relationship is improving and feels relieved and hopeful about a budding friendship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Marilyn's acceptance confirms that she is interested in a social connection beyond work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn values Carolyn's invitation and wants to strengthen their friendship.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To strengthen the friendship and include Marilyn in social plans.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Despite friendly interactions outside work, Carolyn perceives Marilyn still maintaining a professional distance at the bank. When Carolyn raises it, Marilyn says she did not realize it, apologizes, and agrees to talk and improve collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes there is an unexplained professional distance in their work relationship despite their friendly outside interactions; she feels disappointed.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Marilyn was unaware of the perceived distance and is willing to discuss and improve their collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The distance may not be intentional, and Marilyn is open to improving their work dynamic and clarifying expectations and boundaries.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Disappointed and confused initially, then cautiously reassured and hopeful.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To address the work dynamic directly, improve collaboration, and clarify professional expectations and personal boundaries.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After their private meeting, Carolyn feels they cleared the air and understand each other better. She proposes teaming up for the new project proposal, and Marilyn agrees enthusiastically, saying she is glad for the talk and looks forward to working more closely.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes they have cleared the air and better understand each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries; she feels content and optimistic.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Marilyn's enthusiastic agreement reinforces Carolyn's belief that their mutual understanding and partnership are solid.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: They can work more closely together successfully, and their professional partnership is promising.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To team up on the new project and further their collaborative partnership.
